row: Welcome to the  Apollo The Shire channel. This is the story of my horse Apollo and our adventures. From farrier shoeing, to dressage competitions, to fine art paintings. A little bit of everything, Follow along as you enjoy the wonderful life and majesty that is Apollo. Shires are an endangered breed with only 3000 or so left in the world. The more we can learn and appreciate about this amazing breed the better the chance to save them.
